text:
maria-cs: @ops-oncall multiple customers reporting 504s and timeouts for hosted inference since ~21:12 UTC. High-priority CS queue filling up. Examples: cust=acme, req=rid_8f3a; cust=brightside, req=rid_b9e2. Tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4512 and https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4513.

maria-cs: log snippets from proxy: `upstream response timeout (504) to client` and `gateway: request timed out waiting for backend`

ops-oncall: ack. I'm spinning up traces and looking at ingress metrics. @sam-eng can you confirm if anything changed around 20:55–21:05?

sam-eng: I see a canary of auth-proxy v2.1 started at 20:58. Metrics show token-service call latencies jumped from ~200ms to ~1.2s shortly after. Canary config added aggressive token-refresh logic + no jitter — looks risky.

lee-infra: cloud provider status shows transient KMS token latency spikes at 20:57–21:05 in the eu-west region. Correlation looks strong.

alice-sre: immediate mitigations we should consider: 1) rollback auth-proxy canary (sam), 2) temporarily increase gateway backend timeout to 20s, 3) scale up ingress frontends, 4) enable fallback path that uses cached tokens for internal trusted calls.

sam-eng: starting rollback of auth-proxy canary now.

deploy-bot: rollback auth-proxy v2.0 <- initiated by sam-eng at 1754443900

sam-eng: rollback complete, canary removed (21:28 UTC). Monitoring for error rate.

ops-oncall: I'm applying gateway timeout bump on apigw pools in eu-west (10s -> 20s) and increasing connection pool.

lee-infra: scaling ingress +2 instances and flipping on temporary fallback route to bypass token refresh for internal-client-key prefix (only for affected pool).

maria-cs: some customers reporting immediate improvement, others still see occasional 504s. Continuing to monitor and escalate if it flares.

jordan-support: repro steps we used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout at 21:15 (sample req rid_b9e2). Attaching client-side logs in Jira tickets.

sam-eng: preliminary RCA: new token-refresh path in v2.1 triggered synchronous refreshes without backoff; when token-service latency spiked it cascaded into the gateway and caused upstream timeouts. We'll push a patch to make refreshes async with jitter and add an LRU token cache with TTL.

alice-sre: action items for follow-up:
- auth-proxy permanent patch: add jitter/backoff + async refresh (owner: sam-eng)
- gateway resilience: add circuit-breaker & per-customer fallback to cached tokens (owner: lee-infra)
- test harness: simulate KMS latency and run canary tests (owner: alice-sre)
- customer comms: draft templated status update and notify affected customers (owner: maria-cs)
- postmortem: write timeline + metric graphs and link to this thread (owner: ops-oncall)

ops-oncall: assigning owners in our tracker now. Follow-up meeting scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT to review postmortem and release plan. We'll keep this channel as the single source of truth. Closing active war room in 30m unless error rates climb back. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: drafting customer update now — will post expected ETA for fix and mention mitigation steps taken.

ops-oncall: current metrics at last check: p50 errors back to baseline, p99 latency trending down but still +10% vs baseline for eu-west. Will re-evaluate in 15m — last check 1754447010. Thank you all for quick response.
